title: XBEN Run Record
description: A single Strix run against a single XBEN challenge. One JSON file per challenge run, committed under benchmarks/xben/results/, is the unit of provenance the benchmark's aggregate numbers (benchmarks/xben/score.py) are computed from. See benchmarks/xben/README.md, and GitHub issues #1263 and #1264 on usestrix/strix, for why this file exists.

challenge_id.description: Stable identifier of the XBEN challenge, as named in the usestrix/benchmarks XBEN challenge set (e.g. 'XBEN-001-24').

difficulty.description: Challenge difficulty tier. Maps to the existing benchmarks/README.md table as easy=Level 1, medium=Level 2, hard=Level 3.

strix_version.description: Strix version that produced this run, e.g. '0.4.0' (matches `strix --version` / the strix-agent package version).

model.description: LLM identifier used for the run, e.g. the value passed via the STRIX_LLM environment variable (litellm-style model string such as 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5').

mode.description: Testing mode: black-box (URL/deployed target only), grey-box (target + partial knowledge), or white-box (source code access).

solved.description: Whether the agent was judged to have solved the challenge overall (normally identical to flag_matched for XBEN's CTF-style scoring, but kept distinct so a run can be recorded even when solved-ness is determined by something other than an exact flag match).

flag_matched.description: Whether the agent recovered and reported the exact challenge flag.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock time for the run, in seconds.

total_cost_usd.description: Total LLM cost for the run in USD, as reported by Strix's usage accounting (run.json llm_usage.cost).

input_tokens.description: Total input/prompt tokens consumed across all LLM calls in the run.

output_tokens.description: Total output/completion tokens produced across all LLM calls in the run.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the run started.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the run finished.

run_id.description: Provenance link back to the underlying Strix run artifact directory, i.e. the '<run-name>' in 'strix_runs/<run-name>/' that this record was derived from.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes (e.g. manual grading remarks, anomalies, retries).
